text.formatted: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
text.plain: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

text.formatted: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
text.plain: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

text.formatted: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
text.plain: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +4, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

text.formatted: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. _Failure:_ The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).
text.plain: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

text.formatted: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.
text.plain: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.
